'''Shaun Clarke''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2002 Lafayette tournament]] on 24 February 2002 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|turbo BHBM]] and LSC, according to Brian Fred's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3405">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-26-lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2d3405/ lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2], DeckTech (john "comando" matrix, 26 February 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-02-26-lafayette-indiana-2-24-take-2d3405/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
